headline: Louise Lasser, Star of TV’s ‘Mary Hartman,’ Is Dead at 87
context: She began her screen career in Woody Allen movies (he was also her husband), but she was best known for her portrayal of the Ohio housewife in the pigtails and puffed sleeves.
